references.text: This is the direct prophetic source of the cry 'Hosianna' and the blessing over him who comes in the Lord's name, which the people shout out in John 12:13.
Here the king coming to Zion is foretold, humble and riding on a donkey, an image fulfilled in Jesus' entry with palm branches in John 12:13.
Matthew recounts the same event with identical use of palm branches, the cry 'Hosianna', and recognition of him as Israel's king.
Mark documents the same ceremonial action with palm branches and the messianic cry confirming Jesus' kingship.
Luke reports on the people shouting 'Blessed is the king who comes in the Lord's name', a direct parallel to the text in John 12:13.
